fusions.name: Harnessed Fangs
fusions.desc: Your lead hound bites from the traces. The bite deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%). It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Cut the Traces
fusions.desc: Slips the whole sled team at once: 4 hounds run out, spread apart, and each deals 8 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Whole Team Pulling
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Carriage Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs beside your wheels and fights with you, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds. Each kill returns 3 health.
